title: 英国家庭用水的变化
question: The graphs show the residential water use by 5 sections in UK. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
logic: ▪ 概述 用水结构变化 + 排名更替 + 增减对比【整体特征】家庭用水结构发生明显变化（changes in the pattern of residential water consumption）→ 【增长组】厨房、浴室占比上升 → 成为2008 年最大的两类→ 【下降组】花 园、厕所占比下降 → 对比：洗涤仅小幅下降（a slight decrease） ▪ 主一段 1988 年——按占比从高到低排列【最大类别】洗涤占比第一（accounted for the largest share）：25% → 【中间类别】浴室22% → 花园20% → 厕所18%→ 【最小类别】厨房占比最低（the smallest proportion）：15% ▪ 主二段 2008 年——突出排名变化与增减幅度【最大变化：厨房反超】厨房大幅增长（rose sharply）→ 从最低 跃居第一（making it the biggest category）→ 【浴室】同样增长 → 成为第二大用水类别→ 【最大降幅：花园】 大幅下降（fell dramatically）→ 降至最低→ 【其他下降项】厕所占比下降 → 对比：洗涤仅小幅下降（dropped only slightly）

source_nine.en: The two pie charts compare how household water was used in the UK across five categories in 1988 and 2008.
source_nine.cn: 两张饼图比较了1988 年和2008 年英国家庭用水在五种不同用途上的分配情况。

clozes.answer: compare how household water was used in the UK

source_nine.en: Overall, there were clear changes in the pattern of residential water consumption over the period. Water use in kitchens and bathrooms increased and became the two largest categories in 2008, whereas the proportions for gardens and toilets declined. By contrast, washing showed only a slight decrease.
source_nine.cn: 总体而言，在这20 年间，家庭用水的分配结构发生了明显变化。厨房和浴室的用水占比有所上升，并在2008 年成为 占比最大的两个类别，而花园和厕所的用水占比则有所下降。相比之下，洗衣用水的比例仅略有减少。

source_nine.en: In 1988, washing accounted for the largest share of household water use, at 25%. Bathrooms made up 22% of the total, while gardens and toilets were responsible for 20% and 18% respectively. Kitchens used the smallest proportion of water, at just 15%.
source_nine.cn: 1988 年，洗衣用水占家庭总用水量的比例最大，达到25%。浴室用水占总量的22%，而花园和厕所用水的占比分别 为20%和18%。厨房用水所占比例最小，仅为15%。

source_nine.en: By 2008, kitchen use had risen sharply to 29%, making it the biggest category, while the figure for bathrooms also grew to 28%. In contrast, water used for gardens fell dramatically to only 7%, the lowest proportion among the five sections. Toilet use also declined, from 18% to 14%, whereas washing dropped only slightly to 22%.
source_nine.cn: 到了2008 年，厨房用水的占比大幅上升至29%，成为占比最大的类别，而浴室用水的比例也增长至28%。相比之 下，花园用水的占比急剧下降至仅7%，成为五个类别中占比最小的一项。厕所用水的比例也从18%下降至14%，而 洗衣用水则仅小幅下降至22%。
